Primary request: Create one premium studio study of a generic unbranded topical dispenser form. This is a visual-system calibration, not an exact product depiction.

Subject: one sealed soft-touch warm-graphite topical tube with a simple charcoal cap and one blank matte-ivory label plane. The tube is opaque; show no cream, gel, liquid, applicator, carton, or usage scene.
Style/medium: photorealistic premium controlled product photography.
Composition/framing: square 1:1; fixed 20-degree elevated three-quarter view; 85 mm product-photography perspective; centered full object; subject about 68 percent of canvas height; generous even padding; no clipped edges.
Lighting/mood: broad warm key from upper left; restrained cool fill from right; soft controlled shadow down-right; subtle purple-to-teal reflection only along one cap edge.
Color palette: near-black, deep taupe, warm graphite, restrained brushed metal, ivory highlight, subtle purple-to-teal accent.
Text: none. The label plane is completely blank.
Constraints: no claim about contents, formulation, manufacturer, pharmacy, prescription status, certification, or exact package identity. No other objects or props.
Avoid: skin, people, hands, leaves, plants, herbs, botanical or spa cues, wellness props, liquid splashes, clinic rooms, laboratory rooms, medical crosses, logos, brand names, legible text, certification marks, watermarks.
Correction request: Re-render this same private calibration subject with ONLY its framing/camera/scale corrected to the two reference studies. Preserve its subject concept, truthful blank/no-text treatment, materials, palette, lighting and restrained metallic accent. Make one square image, not a collage. The subject silhouette must extend from approximately 17% to 85% of canvas height (about 68% tall), horizontally centered, entirely inside the frame. Keep the softly visible floor/wall horizon at approximately 55% of canvas height; matching the references is more important than the original target's camera angle. Acceptance bands: subject height 61–75%, top margin 16.3–17.9%, horizon 52.1–57.5%. Give the complete subject generous unclipped margins. No reference vials/bottles, no other added objects, no labels or lettering. Do not merely add padding around the original; produce coherent corrected perspective and studio lighting. Image only.
